# awscc_apiportal_product_display_order (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::APIPortal::ProductDisplayOrder. Singleton sub-property of an AWS::APIPortal::Product capturing its display layout (overview page, top-level ProductPage ordering, and sectioned ProductApiPage arrangement).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_id` (String) The identifier of the parent Product. Singleton key for this CFN type.

### Optional

- `contents` (Attributes List) Sectioned arrangement of ProductApiPage ARNs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contents))
- `overview_page_arn` (String) ARN of the ProductPage rendered as the overview/landing page.
- `product_page_arns` (List of String) Top-level ProductPage ARNs in display order.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--contents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contents`

Optional:

- `product_api_page_arns` (List of String) Ordered ProductApiPage ARNs shown under this section. Required; use an empty list for a placeholder section.
- `section_name` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_product_display_order.example
  identity = {
    product_id = "product_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `product_id` (String) The identifier of the parent Product

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_product_display_order.example
  id = "product_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
